responsibility: This implementation module provides manual raw-memory primitives for GNU Modula-2 by copying and zeroing memory word-at-a-time and then byte-at-a-time using SYSTEM pointer arithmetic. It belongs to the low-level runtime support layer and serves as a portable helper for modules that need direct ADDRESS manipulation without relying entirely on libc mem* entry points.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation side of the MemUtils pair: it performs MemCopy and MemZero using SYSTEM WORD and BYTE pointers with explicit loops over word-sized and byte-sized chunks. Unlike gcc/m2/gm2-libs/MemUtils.def, it contains the low-level executable logic.
